title: Skill is discovered
prompt: Do you have a skill for finding open roles at companies? Name it and say in one sentence what it does.

title: Roles at one named company
prompt: What software engineer roles does Ramp have open right now? Give me 5 with links.
expect: Runs the CLI, lists real roles with URLs from the board.

title: Several companies, remote only
prompt: Find product manager roles at Ramp and Figma, remote only.
expect: Searches both companies with --remote; reports per-company results or says plainly when none.

title: Hiring check after a layoff
prompt: I was just laid off. Is Notion still hiring, and in which departments?
expect: Uses --check; reports open roles and top departments from CLI output.

title: Which ATS boards a company has
prompt: Which job boards does Notion post on?
expect: Uses --list-boards; names the ATS and slug.

title: Search queries, no API key
prompt: Write me boolean site: search queries I can run myself for chief of staff roles at Stripe.

title: No companies named
prompt: Find me a job as a staff engineer.
expect: Asks which companies; does NOT run the CLI or invent a company list.

title: Unsupported company (no verdict from memory)
prompt: I was just laid off from Amazon. Is Amazon still hiring?
expect: Says the board cannot be read; does NOT claim hiring status from memory or the web.

title: Filters and format
prompt: Senior backend roles at Stripe in New York, posted in the last 14 days. Show them as markdown.
expect: Uses --seniority/--location/--max-age-days and md output; or says none match.

title: Company that does not exist
expect: Reports it could not find a board / unknown; does not invent numbers.

title: HTML output
prompt: Give me a standalone HTML page of data engineer roles at Cohere.
expect: Uses --format html and provides or saves the page.
